Title: Star Wars: Episode IX - The Rise of Skywalker

Genre: Science Fiction, Action, Adventure

Director: J.J. Abrams

Screenwriters: J.J. Abrams, Chris Terrio, Derek Connolly

Producers: Kathleen Kennedy, Allison Shearmur, Simon Emanuel

Executive Producers: J.J. Abrams, Ben Crawford, Michelle Rejwan

Plot:

In the final installment of the Skywalker saga, the Resistance faces the First Order in a battle to restore peace to the galaxy. Rey, now a trained Jedi, must confront Kylo Ren, her long-lost family, and the darkness within herself.

Act 1:

The film opens with the Resistance celebrating their victory at the end of Star Wars: Episode VIII - The Last Jedi. Rey, Finn, and Poe are hailed as heroes, but their victory was short-lived as the First Order, led by Supreme Leader Snoke and Kylo Ren, retaliates. The Resistance suffers heavy losses, including the death of Vice Admiral Holdo.

Rey, Finn, and Poe escape in the Millennium Falcon and make their way to the planet Kijado, where they meet a group of resistance fighters led by a former First Order stormtrooper named Jannah. She offers to help them by providing a ship to transport the remaining Resistance members to the hidden Jedi temple on the planet Kijado.

Act 2:

The Resistance arrives on Kijado and discovers the temple, which contains the remains of Jedi Master Yoda and Jedi Master Quinlan Vos. Rey learns that she is the granddaughter of Jedi Master Nat, who was a student of Quinlan Vos. She also learns that she has a connection to the Force through her mother, who was a Jedi Knight.

Meanwhile, Kylo Ren, now in possession of Rey's parents' identities, confronts Rey about her true heritage. Rey refuses to join him, and they engage in a lightsaber duel. Rey defeats Kylo Ren, but he escapes, vowing to return with the power of the dark side.

The Resistance, now led by General Organa, devises a plan to infiltrate the First Order's planet of Kijado and destroy their superweapon, the Death Star II. Rey, Finn, and Poe, along with the resistance fighters, infiltrate the planet and engage in a fierce battle with the First Order forces.

Act 3:

During the battle, Rey confronts Kylo Ren once again, this time on the Death Star II. They engage in a lightsaber duel, with Rey using the power of the Force to defeat him. Kylo Ren, realizing that he cannot defeat Rey, sacrifices himself to destroy the Death Star II.

INT. MILLENNIUM FALCON - LIGHTSPEED

Rey meditates in the center of the ship, surrounded by a faint glow. Her breathing is calm and steady. The sound of the stars slipping by creates a melodic hum.

REY
(feeling the Force)
The Force will guide us.

Finn enters the cockpit, taking a seat next to Poe, who is piloting.

FINN
(confidently)
Almost there. The resistance is counting on us.

POE
(nodding)
Then let’s not disappoint them.

The Falcon exits lightspeed smoothly, revealing the distant planet of Exegol shrouded in cosmic mist and crackling energy.

EXT. EXEGOL SPACE - CONTINUOUS

The Millennium Falcon soars towards the foreboding atmosphere, engines roaring with determination. A fleet of Resistance ships follows, a symbol of hope against the dark skies.

INT. SITH TEMPLE - EXEGOL

Kylo Ren walks through the shadowy halls, his lightsaber illuminating the stone walls. Palpatine's voice resonates through the cavernous space.

PALPATINE (V.O.)
You have embraced your destiny, my boy.

Kylo Ren pauses, feeling the chill of the Emperor's presence grow stronger.

KYLO REN
(whispering)
Show me.

A hidden door slides open, revealing a vast chamber filled with Sith artifacts and secrets only known to the dark side.

The script continues to follow our heroes as they confront old foes and face the ultimate battle between light and dark. The climactic journey unfolds with twists and revelations that test the limits of loyalty and courage, marking an end and a new beginning in the galaxy far, far away.

Title: Star Wars: Episode IX - The Rise of Skywalker

Fade in:

EXT. THE STAR DESTROYER - DAY

The First Order's massive Star Destroyer looms over the planet's surface. Kylo Ren stands on the bridge, staring out at the destruction he has wrought.

KYLO REN
(to himself)
This is only the beginning.

He turns to his right, where his mother, Leia Organa, stands. She is wearing a holster, and her lightsaber hangs from her belt.

LEIA ORGANA
(to Kylo)
You don't have to do this. You can come back to the light.

KYLO REN
(to Leia)
I am the light.

Leia steps forward, her eyes locked on her son.

LEIA ORGANA
(to Kylo)
I know you're in there. I can feel it.

Kylo takes a step back, his eyes blazing with anger.

KYLO REN
(to Leia)
You don't know anything. You're just a weak, old woman.

Leia's expression hardens.

LEIA ORGANA
(to Kylo)
I may be old, but I am not weak. I am a Jedi.

Kylo sneers.

KYLO REN
(to Leia)
You're nothing.

Leia ignites her lightsaber, and Kylo ignites his. The two lightsabers clash in a shower of sparks.

CUT TO:

INT. THE REPUBLIC GOVERNMENT BUILDING - DAY

Finn, Rey, and Chewbacca are in a meeting with General Pryde, the leader of the First Order.

GENERAL PRYDE
(to Finn, Rey, and Chewbacca)
The First Order is planning an attack on the Republic. We need to stop them.

FINN
(to General Pryde)
We'll do whatever it takes to help.

CHEWBACCA
(to Finn and Rey)
Wookiee wookiee!

REY
(to Finn and Chewbacca)
We're in this together.

CUT TO:

EXT. THE PLANET'S SURFACE - DAY

Finn, Rey, and Chewbacca are on a reconnaissance mission. They come across a group of stormtroopers, led by Captain Phasma.

CAPTAIN PHASMA
(to Finn, Rey, and Chewbacca)
You're not welcome here.

Finn, Rey, and Chewbacca draw their weapons, ready to fight.

CUT TO:

INT. THE REPUBLIC GOVERNMENT BUILDING - DAY

Finn, Rey, and Chewbacca are in a heated discussion with General Pryde.

GENERAL PRYDE
(to Finn, Rey, and Chewbacca)
We can't just go around attacking the First Order. We need a plan.

FINN
(to General Pryde)
We don't have time for a plan. We need to act now.

CHEWBACCA
(to Finn and Rey)
Wookiee wookiee!

REY
(to Finn and Chewbacca)
We're in this together.

CUT TO:

EXT. THE PLANET'S SURFACE - DAY

Finn, Rey, and Chewbacca are leading a group of Republic soldiers in a battle against the First Order.

The fight is intense, with blaster fire and explosions all around. Finn and Rey are fighting side by side, their lightsabers clashing with the stormtroopers' blasters.

CUT TO:
